name: Craft

components.pose: She kneels at a small stone altar, shaking a bundle of bone and feather charms with one hand and drawing a line of ash across her other palm, her eyes to the camera; full figure visible.
components.effects: Ash and stone shards, dust and glowing crystals lift from the altar in a thin spiral and {{MAGIC}} light gathers on the charms.
